description: Local-only, auditable, non-cloud source control substrate. Provides org and node Gitea deployment topology, SP gateway delegation, policy-gated access, and evidence-backed receipt export.

scaffold_baseline.status: PR-A scaffold — non-mutating, does not imply deployment readiness

org_gitea.description: Organisation-level Gitea instance; authoritative for shared repos and policy mirrors.

node_gitea.description: Per-node Gitea instance for offline-capable local development.

sp_gateway.description: SocioProphet gateway proxy providing authenticated, policy-gated access to both org and node instances.

pr_a_status.note: PR-A (non-mutating scaffold) merged at scaffold_baseline. Does NOT imply deployment readiness. Runtime prerequisites below must be satisfied before transitioning to deployed state.

runtime_prerequisites.description: SP gateway must be deployed and health-checked before source-control traffic is routed.
Direct-bypass controls must be policy-gated; no unauthenticated direct access to org or node Gitea.
SSH and API key rotation procedure must be documented and tested.
Audit log integrity verification must pass for at least one complete event window.
Receipt export pipeline must be live and producing validated receipts consumable by Prophet Platform evidence console.

authority_boundary.note: prophet-platform owns runtime deployment and API contract. gitea-sovereign owns the L0 source-control substrate package and local scaffold.
